decision.die_peak_c: U_mesh 0.0369 C (RR-14 full range over r = 2, 2√2, 4; oscillatory, not a PASS of the order rule) + U_roundoff 1e-6 C (RR-12d floor, 8x the observed 1.2e-7 K), rounded up: 0.037 C
decision.grid_rule: a sealed batch is one 4 x 4 grid, so a cell is never redrawn alone: 1 cell within U is re-solved at r = 4 and, if still within U, the batch is redrawn; more than 1 within U stops the family (the r = 4√2 level returns to the owner, priced)
decision.hydraulic_w: relative 3% of each case's own value: RR-14's 1.4% band plus its geometric tail (2.4%), rounded up; 0.0075 W at the 0.25 W limit
decision.stop: a spot-check label flip, or a hydraulic step above 3%, stops the family; a near-limit hydraulic probe returns to the Validator

scope: DEVELOPMENT reference uncertainty; not a qualification
